## About
Texas Best Transmission is a Christian, family owned and operated shop in Arlington. We've grown mostly by word of mouth, and we'd like to keep it that way by doing honest, quality work.
Robert Clark owns the company and is involved in the day-to-day work to make sure every job is done right. Our technicians are ATSG and ATRA Master-Certified, and we handle automatic, standard and computerized transmissions, along with clutches, differentials, drive shafts and transfer cases.
Customers have given us a 4.5 rating across 85 Google reviews. If something feels off with your transmission, give us a call or stop by 1201 Sturgeon Ct, Suite 121.

## Services
- Transmission repairs, rebuilds and adjustments: Repairs, rebuilds and adjustments for automatic, standard and computerized transmissions.
- Clutches, fly wheels and axles: Clutch, fly wheel and axle work for your vehicle.
- Differential work: Diagnosis and repair of differential problems.
- Drive shafts: Drive shaft service and repair.
- 4 x 4 transfer cases: Transfer case work for your 4 x 4.
- Free diagnostic test: Computer diagnostics to pinpoint what's wrong with your transmission. (Free)

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. Estimates are free on all our repair services. Just give us a call.

Q: Do you work with extended warranty companies?
A: We work with most extended warranty companies. Call us and we can tell you more.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Foreign or domestic, new or old, gas or diesel. Call us and tell us what you drive.

Q: Is there a follow-up after a big repair?
A: Yes. We do a 10 day check-up on all major repairs.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.
